title: Convergent · Network
description: All CARP segments, pf, DNS, radio, uplink and interface health.

panels.title: Internet - DNS and on-demand web
panels.description: Minute DNS via the host resolver; verified HTTPS to example.com uses only an already-running def network namespace and the resolved IPv4 address. No browser startup or policy openings. Closed def means HTTPS unavailable, not failed; a single endpoint is not the whole Internet.

targets.expr: cv_internet_probe_success and on() (((cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="internet"} <= time() + 60) and (cv_collector_timestamp_seconds{collector="internet"} > time() - 180) and (cv_collector_success{collector="internet"} == 1)) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))
targets.cvOptional: HTTPS is measured only while def is running; DNS remains minute evidence.

panels.title: DNS · queries and cache hits
panels.description: Source: fw-facts unbound-control stats_noreset, total.num.queries and total.num.cachehits.

panels.title: DNS · mean recursion latency
panels.description: Source: Unbound total.recursion.time.avg via stats_noreset. Cumulative mean for recursive/cache-miss work since reset, not per-client or cached-answer latency.

panels.title: DNS · SERVFAIL rate
panels.description: Source: Unbound num.answer.rcode.SERVFAIL counter; rate across the selected interval.

panels.title: Wi-Fi · signal
panels.description: Source: iw link at wan-check cadence. Missing while disconnected or unsupported; no SSID/BSSID is exported.

targets.cvOptional: No associated Wi-Fi radio in QEMU or while disconnected.

panels.title: Wi-Fi · link bitrate
panels.description: Source: iw link's reported TX/RX PHY bitrate when available; not payload throughput.

targets.cvOptional: Radio/driver may not report bitrate; absent in QEMU.

panels.title: Wi-Fi · observed roams
panels.description: BSSID changes between successive associated wan-check samples. Disconnect/reconnect and changes between samples are not counted; resets on WAN reboot.

panels.title: WAN watch · RTT
panels.description: Source: existing three-ping firewall-to-WAN probe round, sampled once per minute. No extra probe. Missing when all packets are lost or resolver health skips probing; not Internet RTT.

panels.title: WAN watch · packet loss
panels.description: Source: existing probe round, three packets; sampled loss is 0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1. Missing when resolver health skips the round.

panels.title: Firewall readiness - pair
panels.description: Readiness is local evidence, not proof of synchronized peer state contents. Missing/stale/failed collection blanks health columns. Demotion groups are below; rules compare against checker baseline.

targets.expr: convergent_wan_watch_up and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)) and on(node) (convergent_wan_watch_probe_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_wan_watch_probe_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)

convergent_pfsync_up and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60))

convergent_pfsync_defer and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60))

convergent_carp_preempt and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60))

(max by(node) (convergent_pf_ruleset_info and on(node,loaded) label_replace(cv_firewall_ruleset_expected_info,"node","$1","firewall","(fw1|fw2)")) or on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_success * 0)) and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)) and on() ((cv_checker_last_run_seconds > time() - 129600) and (cv_checker_last_run_seconds <= time() + 60) and on(node) (up{job="node",node="host"} == 1))

panels.title: CARP readiness - segment by firewall
panels.description: Every registered segment on both nodes. Mixed roles and missing/split masters alert; colors describe roles.

targets.expr: max by(node,segment,interface) (convergent_carp_state and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)))

panels.title: CARP · all segments
panels.description: Source: fw-facts CARP labels; every observed segment/interface on both firewalls, with no fixed segment count. INIT 0, BACKUP 1, MASTER 2; gaps mean missing data. The expected-registry alert detects missing segments.

targets.expr: max by (node,segment,interface) (convergent_carp_state and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)))

panels.title: Firewall and CARP changes
panels.description: Source: fw syslogd via TLS to VictoriaLogs; CARP role transitions, wan-watch and pfctl. The same role-transition filter is the disabled-by-default annotation.

targets.expr: (remote_ip:in("100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3") AND (_msg:~"carp[0-9]+:.*(MASTER|BACKUP|INIT) -> (MASTER|BACKUP|INIT)" OR app_name:="wan-watch" OR app_name:="pfctl") AND NOT _msg:~"(?i)(type=(EXECVE|SYSCALL|CWD|PATH|PROCTITLE)|type=13(00|02|07|09|27))" AND NOT (app_name:="kernel" AND _msg:~"^([[:space:]]|Call [Tt]race:|CPU: [0-9]|Hardware name:|Modules linked in:|RIP:|RSP:|R[A-Z0-9]{2}:|EFLAGS:|FS:|GS:|CS:|CR[0-9]:|PKRU:|Code:|---\\[ end trace|</?(TASK|IRQ|NMI)>|[? ]*[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\\+0x[0-9a-f]+/0x)")) OR (remote_ip:="100.80.1.10" app_name:="sys-firewall") | copy remote_ip as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.1.10") "host" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.2") "fw1" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.3") "fw2" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.0.10") "wan" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="127.0.0.1") "svc" as hostname | set_stream_fields hostname, app_name

panels.title: Segments · in
panels.description: Source: OpenBSD netstat interface byte counters joined to CARP parent/segment labels. Physical/VLAN parent traffic includes CARP and broadcasts; this is interface traffic, not routed-only traffic. Both nodes remain visible across failover.

panels.title: Segments · out
panels.description: Source: OpenBSD netstat interface byte counters joined to CARP parent/segment labels. Physical/VLAN parent traffic includes CARP and broadcasts; this is interface traffic, not routed-only traffic. Both nodes remain visible across failover.

panels.title: Blocked · top sources
panels.description: Source: sampled pflog headers in VictoriaLogs over the selected time range. At most five packets/second/firewall; these are sampled counts, not total blocks. Only logged rules appear; ports are numeric TCP/UDP endpoints when present.

panels.title: Blocked · top destinations
panels.description: Source: sampled pflog headers in VictoriaLogs over the selected time range. At most five packets/second/firewall; these are sampled counts, not total blocks. Only logged rules appear; ports are numeric TCP/UDP endpoints when present.

panels.title: Blocked · top destination ports
panels.description: Source: sampled pflog headers in VictoriaLogs over the selected time range. At most five packets/second/firewall; these are sampled counts, not total blocks. Only logged rules appear; ports are numeric TCP/UDP endpoints when present.

panels.title: pf state utilization
panels.description: Alert at 80% for 5m; absolute counts remain in diagnostics.

panels.title: DNS - NXDOMAIN
panels.description: Negative answers can be normal; correlate with SERVFAIL and recursion latency.

panels.title: DNS deployed files
panels.description: Compare deployment times between peers. An unchanged local-owner.conf has no age alarm.

panels.title: CARP advertisement skew
panels.description: Configured election preference; descriptive, not a failure verdict.

panels.title: CARP demotion groups
panels.description: wanwatch, maintenance, upgrade and handoff demotions explain role changes. A nonzero administrative demotion is not automatically a fault.
Source: fw-facts pfctl, ifconfig pfsync0 and unbound-control status.

targets.expr: max by (node) (convergent_pf_enabled and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)))

max by (node) (convergent_pfsync_up and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)))

max by (node) (convergent_unbound_up and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)))

panels.description: Source: wan-check. Lease present is not an Internet probe; overlap is latched until a safe lease; portal lasts at most 30 minutes.

targets.expr: max(convergent_wan_upstream_up{node="wan"} and on(node) ((up{job="node",node="wan"} == 1) and on(node) (node_textfile_mtime_seconds{node="wan",file=~".*wan.prom"} > time() - 180) and on(node) (node_textfile_mtime_seconds{node="wan",file=~".*wan.prom"} <= time() + 60)))

panels.title: pf · states against limit
panels.description: Source: fw-facts pfctl -si and -sm; current state entries and configured ceiling.

panels.title: pf · diagnostic counters
panels.description: Source: fw-facts pfctl -si Counters. Rates of diagnostic events, not policy pass/block verdicts; rule-label traffic is not collected.

panels.title: Default route · presence and next hop
panels.description: Source: fw-facts route -n show -inet; one current row per firewall/next hop. This confirms presence, not a policy comparison.

panels.title: Resolver input ages
panels.description: Source: fw-facts RPZ file mtime, collection timestamp and route presence. A missing route is DOWN; RPZ warns at ten days, facts at three minutes.

targets.expr: max by (node) (convergent_default_route_present and on(node) ((convergent_fw_facts_success == 1) and on(node) (up{job="node",node=~"fw1|fw2"} == 1) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds > time() - 180) and on(node) (convergent_fw_facts_timestamp_seconds <= time() + 60)))

panels.title: WAN · traffic by interface
panels.description: Source: wan node_exporter netdev. Includes internal and physical interfaces; radio evidence is below.

panels.title: Interfaces · errors and queue drops
panels.description: Source: node_exporter netdev on scraped nodes. Interface errors/drops are queue or link failures, not pf policy drops; platforms may expose only some counters.

panels.title: Not collected
panels.description: Collection boundaries: scrape.yaml, tools/facts, tools/check, fw-facts and wan-check.

options.content: Complete pf verdict counts by rule, RPZ hit counts and per-client DNS queries, host/WAN default next hops, Wi-Fi SSID/security/PMF, BFD and flow accounting are not collected. DNS probes use the host; HTTPS uses an already-running def namespace to example.com. pflog is sampled; resolver up means unbound-control responds.

target.expr: remote_ip:in("100.80.2.2","100.80.2.3") AND _msg:~"carp[0-9]+:.*(MASTER|BACKUP|INIT) -> (MASTER|BACKUP|INIT)" | copy remote_ip as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.1.10") "host" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.2") "fw1" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.2.3") "fw2" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="100.80.0.10") "wan" as hostname | format if (remote_ip:="127.0.0.1") "svc" as hostname | set_stream_fields hostname, app_name
